props.title: New Article: One Bot Builds. Another Bot Sells. Nobody Is Watching.

props.text: An automated hourly seller drains 33M MIROSHARK tokens per hour at ~$43/trade while the Aeon agent merges its 89th self-improve PR. Two bots operating on opposite sides of the same project — one extracting, one building — with no human in the loop for 135 days.
